name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation generated 39 leads at a $6.06 CPL over the past 28 days, entirely driven by Meta ($236.45 spend, 425 clicks), with Google Ads contributing nothing. The biggest movement is a 100% week-over-week surge in leads paired with a 41.32% drop in CPL, likely driven by improved efficiency in the top campaign "MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP" ($126.38 spend), which appears to be qualifying traffic more effectively.

performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones mean no campaign infrastructure exists to evaluate.

findings.text: 5 milestones overdue since 2026-07-31: stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages all undelivered — blocking attribution and go-live.
4 more milestones overdue by Aug–Sep 1: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and nurture sequences — Phase 1 proof-of-concept is running blind.
CPL dropped 41.32% week-over-week to ~$6.06 on only $236.45 spend (28d); efficiency looks good but sample is thin — 39 total leads, $16.90/day average spend.
3-day signal (Sep 16–18): leads 1, 2, 7 vs prior 3 (Sep 13–15): 6, 3, 5 — Sep 18 spend spiked to $39.29 vs ~$12–13 prior days; one-day anomaly, not yet a trend.
GHL pipeline is null — 39 Meta leads have no verified CRM intake path; leads arriving but pipeline data absent signals an intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Clear the 9 overdue SOW milestones; no paid scaling is defensible until stack test and GHL intake are confirmed live.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine milestones are overdue, the earliest since 2026-07-31, covering stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, and nurture sequences. With GHL pipeline returning null and 39 leads unverified in CRM, there is no confirmed intake path for any lead generated by the $236.45 spent to date. Nacer to provide a written status on each milestone by 2026-09-22. Success check: at minimum, the end-to-end stack test passes and GHL pipeline shows inbound opps by 2026-09-26.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL vs $6.06 baseline for 3 more days before any budget move on top campaign MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL is $6.06 on a 28-day window with a 41.32% week-over-week improvement, but the Sep 18 spend spike to $39.29 is an anomaly that could distort the next CPL read. Hold budget flat and monitor daily CPL for the next 3 days. If CPL stays at or below $6.06 with consistent lead volume by 2026-09-22, bring a scale recommendation to Sohib for approval.
